headline: Madison Heights Rooftop Reserve
articleBody:
Structural rooftop with 20' plunge pool, living bamboo privacy screen, and modular kitchen island. Lightweight carbon-fiber decking reduced load 60%. Hurricane-rated glass railings preserve panoramas.

Outcome: 11-week install. LEED Platinum. Luxury rental generates $120K/year. Instagram influencer showcase 1.2M impressions.
